description: Disciplined process hooks - hybrid command + prompt hooks with rigor-aware gating

SessionStart.description: Initialize disciplined process, detect tracker, check MCP health

UserPromptSubmit.description: Inject current DP phase, active task, and rigor tier as context
Workflow ordering nudge for non-trivial work

hooks.prompt: Consider the DP phase context injected by hooks. If you're about to implement code: have tests been written first? Is there a spec for this feature? For bug fixes and trivial changes (<20 lines in familiar code), skip this check. For new features or changes >20 lines, follow the DP phase order: spec before test, test before implement.

BLOCKING: Before committing, verify that all relevant tests pass. If you haven't run tests for the changes being committed, run them now. Do not proceed with the commit until tests pass. If there are no tests for the changed code, note this as a gap.

PreToolUse.description: Phase-aware spec reference gate for implementation files

PostToolUse.description: Validate spec trace markers after implementation edits
Validate spec trace markers after file writes

Stop.description: Check for uncommitted changes and open tasks before session end

hooks.prompt: Before ending: (1) Were specs or ADRs needed but not created? (2) Were tests written before implementation? (3) Has bd sync --flush-only been run? Briefly note any gaps.
